title: 第11章 柳梦兮第12章 记住了我冷清璃爱你
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
忆无情看向叶河，眼中灰暗不明。沉声道：“你可知你在说什么？”
“我知道，但让我等放弃通天古路……我等……不甘心啊！”叶河眼神坚定，直视忆无情。
忆无情沉默了，他也知道他如此必是将自己放在所有人的对立面，到了外界必将寸步难移。
他也知道他如此定会让仙界此代的天骄视他为一生之敌。
若他执意如此那便是毁了仙界此代的天骄。
“我想要出去，不能在等，若是不愿出去……那便死！”忆无情缓缓站起身，淡淡道。
“忆兄……”见到忆无情的表情，叶河一时不知该如何劝导。
忆无情望向远方，心中默默思绪。
他想出去，想去看看自己的父母，当年他们走时自己连最后一面都没见过他们，但现如今能出去定要第一时间出去，去他们坟前祭拜。
他还想去看看自己的宗门凌天宗现如今变成了什么，当年是为何突然解散。
关于这些，他的内心很渴望。
他虽活了许久，但大多时间都是在无意识状态。
他不似名字一般，无情，相反他很重感情，就算到了现在，他还是会经常想起往事。
“孩子不必纠结，老夫或许有个两全其美的方法。”一位白发老者突然出现在忆无情身前，将一旁的叶河吓了一跳。
“守守守……护者？”叶河瞪大双眼。
“嗯？”忆无情愣了一下，这老头自从他十万年前夺得第一之时便出现过，正是他给了自己最后的奖励，就是一件禁忌古器。
往后每次他夺得第一之时都会出现，给自己一件禁忌古器。
一回生，二回熟，这老头对他的态度还不错。
他也知道老头的身份，此地的守护者，实力不明，但肯定比大帝强。
“前辈。”忆无情恭敬道，这位守护者还是对自己很照顾的，每次见面都会指点自己一些。

“嗯。”守护者微微一笑：“你想出去，还很急，但又想直接拿第一……此事老夫有办法。”
“请前辈指点。”忆无情道。
“让所有人都承认你是本次的第一，这样的话本次通天古路的冠军就是你，哪怕你现在离开。”
此话一出，叶河当场就愣住了，特喵的还能这么玩。
忆无情沉思一会，开口道：“如此甚好。”
说罢忆无情，飞向空中，高声道：“诸位，无情有个不情之请，本次冠军便由无情收下，可有意见？”
“有意见的可以直说.”
……
看到场面一片寂静，忆无情满意了，看向守护者，笑道：“前辈，这样可好？”
守护者额间露出几条黑线，沉声道：“你这小子不把你的的神通收了他们如何说话！”
忆无情无奈，这不一样吗。
忆无情一挥手，下方所有人便感觉浑身轻松，纷纷站起来看着忆无情，神色各异，但大多都是十分屈辱。
他们那个不是一方天骄，高傲无比，却受到了如此大辱，如何能坦然自若。
忆无情没有理会他们的眼神，开口道：“各位可有意见？”
“我……唔！”
一位想要出声的男子瞬间倒下，不知为何。
众人：“……”
守护者：“……”
叶河：“6。”
沉默片刻，李践剑率先开口：“当然，我李践剑承认自己技不如人，无情公子作为本次的第一李某绝对赞成。”

“俺也一样！”
content_en:
Yi Qingqing looked at Ye He, his eyes dark and unclear. He said in a deep voice: "Do you know what you are talking about?"
"I know, but if we are asked to give up the ancient road to the sky... we... are not willing to do so!" Ye He's eyes were firm and he looked directly at Yi Wuqing.
Yi Qingqing was silent. He also knew that by doing this, he would put himself on the opposite side of everyone, and he would be unable to move even an inch when he entered the outside world.
He also knew that if he acted like this, the geniuses of this generation in the immortal world would regard him as their lifelong enemy.
If he insists on doing this, he will be the genius who will ruin this generation of the immortal world.
"I want to go out. I can't wait. If you don't want to go out... then you will die!" Yi Qingwu stood up slowly and said calmly.
"Brother Yi..." Seeing Yi's ruthless expression, Ye He didn't know how to persuade him.
Yi Wuqing looks into the distance, silently thinking in her heart.
He wanted to go out and see his parents. He didn't even see them for the last time when they left. But now that he can go out, he must go out as soon as possible and pay homage to their graves.
He also wanted to see what his sect Lingtian Sect had become now and why it was suddenly disbanded back then.
Regarding these, his heart longed for them.
Although he lived for a long time, he was unconscious most of the time.
He is not as ruthless as his name suggests. On the contrary, he is very emotional. Even now, he still often thinks of the past.
"Children, don't worry, I may have a way to get the best of both worlds." A white-haired old man suddenly appeared in front of Yi Qingqing, startling Ye He beside him.
"Shou, shou, shou... protector?" Ye He's eyes widened.
"Huh?" Yi Wuqing was stunned for a moment. This old man had appeared since he won the first place a hundred thousand years ago. It was he who gave him the final reward, which was a forbidden ancient artifact.
From now on, every time he wins first place, he will appear and give himself a forbidden ancient artifact.
Once familiar, second time familiar, the old man's attitude towards him was pretty good.
He also knows the identity of the old man, the guardian of this place. His strength is unknown, but he is definitely stronger than the emperor.
"Senior." Yi Qingqing said respectfully. This guardian still took good care of him and would give him some advice every time he met.
"Yeah." The guardian smiled slightly: "You want to go out, you are still in a hurry, but you also want to get first place... I have a way to do this."
"Senior, please give me some advice." Yi Qingqing said.
"Let everyone admit that you are the number one this time. In this case, the champion of Tongtian Ancient Road will be you, even if you leave now."
As soon as these words came out, Ye He was stunned on the spot, it was so weird that he could still play like this.
Yi Qingqing thought for a while and then said: "That's very good."
After saying that, Yi Qingqing flew into the air and said loudly: "Everyone, Wuqing has a request from Wuqing. I will accept Wuqing's championship this time. Do you have any opinions?"
"If you have any opinions, you can speak up."
…
Seeing that the scene was completely silent, Yi Qingqing was satisfied. He looked at the guardian and said with a smile, "Senior, is this good?"
A few black lines appeared on the guardian's forehead, and he said solemnly: "You kid, how can they talk unless you take away your magical powers!"
I remember being ruthless and helpless, isn't this different?
Yi Wuqing waved his hand, and everyone below felt relaxed. They all stood up and looked at Yi Wuqing, with different expressions, but most of them were very humiliated.
They are not a genius, they are extremely arrogant, but they have been so humiliated, how can they be calm and composed.
Yi Qingqing ignored their looks and said, "Do you have any opinions?"
"I...um!"
A man who wanted to speak out fell instantly for unknown reasons.
Everyone: "..."
Guardian: "..."
Ye He: "6."
After a moment of silence, Li Jianjian was the first to speak: "Of course, I, Li Jianjian, admit that my skills are inferior to others. Mr. Wu, as the number one this time, Li absolutely agrees."
"Me too!"
